subject.title: Feature: notify sender on WhatsApp after pairing approval

question: Should maintainers sponsor a gateway-backed WhatsApp pairing approval notifier for the existing `--notify` flow now, despite the prior proof-heavy PRs closing unmerged?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the practical fix likely needs a gateway-backed delivery seam or accepted plugin SDK shape plus live WhatsApp proof, which prior contributor PRs did not finish.

options.title: Sponsor gateway-backed notifier
options.body: Approve a focused repair that reuses the existing `--notify` flow, keeps notification opt-in, and requires redacted live WhatsApp or gateway proof before merge.

options.title: Keep issue open until live proof owner exists
options.body: Do not queue another repair until a maintainer or contributor can provide the WhatsApp proof path that blocked the prior PRs.

options.title: Broaden product scope
options.body: If maintainers want default-on approval notification or blocked-message replay, split that into a separate product design instead of folding it into the narrow bug repair.

recommendation.title: Sponsor gateway-backed notifier
recommendation.body: Approve a focused repair that reuses the existing `--notify` flow, keeps notification opt-in, and requires redacted live WhatsApp or gateway proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and feature history point to the shared pairing and WhatsApp plugin seams he recently changed.
